---

Join the AI Community of Practice for its weekly gathering beginning January 7, 2026. This virtual meeting, held via Zoom, offers attendees the opportunity to connect with fellow AI enthusiasts, share insights, and collaborate on projects. Participants can expect engaging discussions on the latest trends and challenges in artificial intelligence. Whether you are a seasoned professional or just starting in the field, this gathering provides a supportive environment to enhance your knowledge and network with like-minded individuals. Don't miss this chance to be part of a growing community dedicated to exploring the future of AI.
